# UI: General

The UI is programmatic DOM code under [src/ui](../../../src/ui). Panels receive EventBus and state references, render controls, wire events, and publish domain actions.

| Surface | Module | Observed responsibility |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Law controls | [src/ui/lawPanel.js](../../../src/ui/lawPanel.js) | Category-grouped toggles, slate Mechanics section and law events |
| World controls | [src/ui/worldPanel.js](../../../src/ui/worldPanel.js) | World parameters, presets and setup |
| Tooltip/help | [src/ui/tooltip.js](../../../src/ui/tooltip.js) | Law lookup, help tiers and toggle affordance |
| Persistence | [src/ui/savePanel.js](../../../src/ui/savePanel.js) | Save, restore, compare, undo and redo |
| Analytics | eco, group, DNA, intel and narrative panels | Inspection surfaces for emergent state |

Functional UI evidence is separated from appearance evidence so interaction regressions and visual regressions remain independently reviewable.
